title: Reject empty custom timesteps with a clear error
request: As a library consumer, I want an empty custom timestep list passed to DDPM set_timesteps to produce a clear ValueError, while valid custom timesteps, count-based inference timesteps, and the existing mutually exclusive argument error stay unchanged.
proposed_approach: Raise ValueError for an empty timesteps list inside set_timesteps, after the existing one-argument check and before indexing the first timestep. Do not replace the empty list with a default timestep.

criteria.text: Both DDPM implementations reject empty custom timesteps with a useful ValueError; passing both arguments still raises the existing conflict error first.
Normal and single-element custom timesteps retain their values and CPU device.
Passing both timestep arguments still raises the existing error.
Existing count-based inference timesteps still work.

exclusions: No automatic replacement of invalid input
No publication to the upstream Hugging Face repository
